facts.text: If the full proposal cannot be delivered responsibly, fallback options should preserve safety rather than the headline schedule.

facts.text: The first automatic-braking release should cover only machine families, motions, conditions and sites where the safety case is closed, such as reverse-only operation, a speed band or named models.
facts.quote: Release automatic braking only for machine families, motions, conditions and sites where the safety case is closed, for example reverse only, a speed band, named models.

facts.text: Volvo CE's restricted automatic-braking precedent covers reverse operation at 3 to 15 km/h on selected models.

facts.text: Warning-only behavior should be retained outside the released automatic-braking operating envelope.

facts.text: ISO 21815 distinguishes forward and reverse scopes from swing and rotation scopes, supporting explicit functional boundaries.

facts.text: Motion inhibit at start-up is recommended as a fallback before full dynamic braking.
facts.quote: Motion inhibit at start-up before full dynamic braking.

facts.text: Caterpillar inhibits reverse engagement when the machine has been stationary for at least 15 seconds and an object is in the critical zone; the passage describes this as a lower-hazard intervention.

facts.text: Warning plus a brief brake pulse as an alert is a recommended fallback option.

facts.text: A fallback release should ship with shadow-mode logging enabled and expand its operating envelope by update as evidence accrues.

facts.text: Shadow-mode logging should record when the automatic-braking algorithm would have braked without actuating.

facts.text: Barrick's phased approach observed events and operator feedback before stronger intervention.

facts.text: Under the Product Liability Directive (PLD), updates within the manufacturer's control remain within liability.

facts.text: Virtual testing should be used primarily for regression and prioritization as a fallback.
facts.quote: Use virtual testing primarily for regression and prioritization.

facts.text: Even if virtual testing cannot replace most final physical evidence by mid-2027, virtual testing can improve defect discovery, scenario exploration and selection of the most informative physical tests; NASA and ASME practice and the heavy-truck program support this hybrid role.

facts.text: Pilot sites should be selected for strong data, trained staff, controlled change management and rapid engineering support, under explicit operational controls, rather than claiming immediate coverage of every site type.

facts.text: Physical testing should be retained for weak-model regions, with likely candidates including poor sensor-environment correlation, highly variable machine dynamics, significant configuration changes and high consequences of an incorrect brake.
facts.quote: Likely candidates are poor sensor-environment correlation, highly variable machine dynamics, significant configuration changes and high consequences of an incorrect brake.

facts.text: The weak-model regions requiring retained physical testing must be determined empirically; the brief does not support naming a fraction of physical testing to retain.
facts.quote: Which regions these are must be determined empirically; the brief does not support naming a fraction.

facts.text: Automatic-braking release should be split by machine family: a family with demonstrated sensor and dynamics portability need not wait for a family whose models failed correlation.

facts.text: Success of automatic-braking validation for one machine family must not imply coverage of other machine families.
facts.quote: one family's success must not imply coverage of the rest.

facts.text: An inadequately defined third-party braking interface should not be integrated merely to meet the release date.
facts.quote: Do not integrate an inadequately defined third-party braking interface to hold the date.

facts.text: Barrick's program warned about OEM cooperation and unintended consequences at the third-party braking interface.

facts.text: The southern-hemisphere winter in mid-2027 should be used for cold-weather testing.
facts.quote: Use the southern-hemisphere winter in mid-2027 for cold-weather testing.

facts.text: Full release scope should be delayed rather than claiming a virtual equivalence that cannot be defended.
facts.quote: Delay the full scope rather than claim a virtual equivalence that cannot be defended.

facts.text: If the safety case is incomplete, delaying the brake-control feature while retaining the validated warning function is more responsible than converting unresolved uncertainty into operator exposure.
